cells.text: SWAASHPET - products waiting for factory information
These 72 products cannot be run in the software yet. Each one is missing something only the factory knows.
Please fill ONLY the yellow columns. Leave everything else as it is.
Sheet "Products to complete" - all 72 in one list.
- "What is missing" tells you what each product needs.
- Suggestions 1-3 are our best guesses at the Tally name. If one is right, write it in the yellow column.
- If none is right, please write the correct exact Tally name.
Sheet "Packing needed" - the 40 that need bottles per tray / per box.
Sheet "Colour questions" - 5 products where the colour is unclear.
IMPORTANT: the Tally name must be exact, letter for letter. We never guess a name -
a wrong name makes the Tally voucher fail.
Send the file back and we will load it. Nothing changes in Tally.
